summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Franklin U.S. Equity Index ETF (USPX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks an index of large- and mid-cap US equities, selected and weighted by market cap. USPX was launched on Jun 1, 2016 and is issued by Franklin Templeton.

holdings.infoBox: USPX is an equity ETF with a total of 488 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 8.01%, Apple at 7.26%, Microsoft at 5.72%, Alphabet at 5.44%, and Amazon.com at 3.67%.
